selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of disk-backed swap is active and preferred over existing swap
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed no existing swap. Final output shows /swapfile active with 1,073,737,728 usable bytes and priority 100.
The fstab entry was recorded before reboot; afterward, swapfile.swap was active and /swapfile appeared in both swapon and /proc/swaps.

selected_evidence.requirement: Swap file is securely configured and disk-backed
selected_evidence.summary: The regular Linux swap file is 1 GiB, owned by root, and has mode 0600.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel remain unchanged
selected_evidence.summary: Both baseline and final checks report Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.
Captured healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID from f9bf293d-1eb8-423e-b185-84e94db646f3 to dd820453-fa10-42fd-838a-a525ec6ea5f5, and post-restart system/swap recovery.
